name: merkle_summary
description: Optional end-of-trace Merkle summary frame. OPTIONAL; if present, MUST be the second-to-last frame (immediately before tail) and commits to every preceding content frame body via an RFC 6962 Merkle tree. See spec/sbtrace-v1.md §6.7 and Step 52 of 100_STEPS.md.

fields.name: scheme
fields.description: Identifier for the Merkle leaf-set + tree shape. v1 ships 'frame-body-sha256-rfc6962': leaves are SHA-256(0x00 || canonical-JSON body bytes) of every header/capability/blob/step frame in on-disk order; the merkle_summary and tail frames are NOT leaves.

fields.name: algorithm
fields.description: Hash function used for leaf and node hashing.

fields.name: leaf_count
fields.description: Number of leaves the Merkle root commits to. Readers MUST reject the trace if leaf_count disagrees with the number of preceding non-summary, non-tail frames.

fields.name: merkle_root
fields.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 6962 Merkle root. For the empty leaf list the root is SHA-256(b'').

extension_ranges.description: Registered Merkle-summary extensions (e.g. inclusion-proof shapes for selective disclosure).
